item_name: Rothco Stainless Steel Folding Camp Stove
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Stainless Steel Folding Camp Stove is a compact and collapsible camping cooker that is designed to take up minimal space in your bag. This easy-to-use camping stove is a must-have for your next camping trip.
description: Rothco’s Stainless Steel Folding Camp Stove is a compact and collapsible camping cooker that is designed to take up minimal space in your bag. This easy-to-use cooker is a must-have for your next camping trip. The camp stove measures 8.25 inches x 5.5 inches x 5.5 inches open and 8.25 inches x 5.5 inches x 1.5 inches closed. The camping wood stove consists of three components: A steel stove base, removable grill plate, and ash pan. The camp stove is constructed from durable stainless-steel materials for years of reliable use. You can open and close the portable camping stove with the rotating switch for easy heat control, it is compatible with wood, twigs, coal, fuel tablets, and more. The camping stove features ample ventilation holes for optimal airflow and comes with a zippered carrying case.
